sloka: इति सा लक्ष्मणेन उक्ता कराला निर्णतोदरी ।मन्यते तत् वचः सत्यम् परिहास अविचक्षणा ॥३-१८-१३॥
transliteration: iti sā lakṣmaṇena uktā karālā nirṇatodarī ।manyate tat vacaḥ satyam parihāsa avicakṣaṇā ॥3-18-13॥

translations.english: While Lakshmana was thus making fun of the dreadful, droopingbellied Surpanakha, she presumed his words to be true.
